adjudication.rationale: In apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts the code looks up an existing credential via prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId: reqBody.userId, appId: appMetadata.slug } }) and then updates only that single returned record. `findFirst` is nondeterministic when multiple rows match (no `orderBy`), so if a user can have multiple credentials for the same appId, this will arbitrarily update one and leave the others unchanged/stale. The diff does not show any DB-level uniqueness on (userId, appId) that would guarantee at most one match, so the handler itself does not enforce the “single credential per user per app” invariant.
